name: @endbug/github-label-sync
description: Synchronise your GitHub labels with as few destructive operations as possible

scripts.test: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm build && pnpm test:smoke
scripts.test:smoke: node -e "const githubLabelSync = require('.'); if (typeof githubLabelSync !== 'function') throw new Error('CommonJS export is not callable'); if (!githubLabelSync.defaults) throw new Error('CommonJS defaults missing');" && node -e "import('@endbug/github-label-sync').then((mod) => { if (typeof mod.default !== 'function') throw new Error('ESM default export missing'); if (typeof mod.githubLabelSync !== 'function') throw new Error('ESM named export missing'); })" && node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['dist/cjs/bin.cjs', '--help'], { encoding: 'utf8' }); if (result.status !== 0) throw new Error(result.stderr); if (!result.stdout.includes('Usage: github-label-sync')) throw new Error(result.stdout);"
